title: View a GitHub pull request in the web browser
summary: Open a specific pull request in your default web browser using its number, URL, or branch name. This is useful for reviewing code changes and comments.
prerequisites: You are logged in to GitHub with gh auth login

steps.explain: Open the specified pull request in your default web browser.

placeholders.name: PR_NUMBER_OR_URL_OR_BRANCH
placeholders.description: The PR number (e.g., 456), the full URL, or the branch name
